pois.label: 钻塔与天车
pois.detail: 10 m 箱型桁架钻塔，主弦杆 320 mm 重型构件，顶部为密封天车房（滑轮组全封闭防尘），中层设检修平台。底部敞开跨内嵌钻井房，钻具经房顶密封孔下放。火星大气稀薄、风压极小，塔架设计余量主要留给运输与搬迁工况——井寿命到期后整塔拖运 15 m 至预留井位复用。
pois.detail_en: A 10 m box-truss derrick on 320 mm heavy chords, topped by a sealed crown-block house that keeps the sheaves out of the dust, with a service platform at mid-height. The drill house sits inside the open bottom bay and the string runs down through a sealed port in its roof. Martian air is far too thin for wind loading to size the structure, so the margin is spent on transport and relocation instead: when the well is spent, the whole derrick is dragged 15 m to the pre-surveyed second site and reused.

specs_en.Relocation: dragged whole, re-set on a new pad

pois.label: 钻井房（密封井口）
pois.detail: 保温舱体包住井口。关键约束：火星地表压强约 0.6 kPa，低于 0 °C 液态水的饱和蒸气压——井口若不密封，井下融腔的水会直接沸腾流失。密封后腔内自平衡于约 0.7 kPa 水蒸气分压。井筒穿过 3.4 m 干燥/冰胶结风化层段下钢套管，之后裸眼进入块状纯冰层。
pois.detail_en: An insulated shed wraps the wellhead. One constraint shapes everything here: surface pressure is about 0.6 kPa, below the vapour pressure of liquid water at 0 C, so an unsealed wellhead would boil the cavity dry. Sealed, the bore self-balances at roughly 0.7 kPa of water vapour. The hole is cased through 3.4 m of dry, ice-cemented regolith, then runs open-hole into massive clean ice.
sim: Stefan 移动边界校核（TS-01 R1）：15 kW 井寿命 > 1 火星年（669 sol）；12 kW 仅约 450 sol——准稳态模型曾高估 75%
井寿命机制：融腔随累计取水长大（每 380 L 扩腔 0.41 m³），壁面传导损失随半径上涨，功率买的是井的寿命而非产水率
sim_en: Stefan moving-boundary check (TS-01 R1): at 15 kW the well outlives one Mars year (669 sol); at 12 kW it lasts only about 450 sol. The earlier quasi-steady model had overstated life by 75%.

Why power buys life, not rate: every 380 L drawn enlarges the melt cavity by 0.41 m3, wall area grows with radius and conduction loss grows with it. The heater budget buys well lifetime, not extraction rate.

pois.label: 保温输水管线
pois.detail: DN25 输水管，5 cm 气凝胶毡保温（k = 0.02 W/m·K），10 W/m 自限温伴热带，全线（地面段+井筒立管 14 m）装机 140 W。按 2% 坡度敷设，伴热断电即重力排空回井（drain-back），管线本体零冻结风险。井下配 24 VDC 隔膜泵双泵冗余，绞车下放随水面下沉补偿。
pois.detail_en: A DN25 water line under 5 cm of aerogel blanket (k = 0.02 W/m.K) with 10 W/m self-regulating heat trace - 140 W installed across the ground run plus the 14 m riser in the bore. It is laid at 2% fall so that losing trace power simply drains the line back into the well; the pipe itself cannot freeze. Down-hole, a redundant pair of 24 VDC diaphragm pumps hangs on a winch that pays out as the water level drops.
pois.sim: 冷工况（水 +2 °C / 夜间 193 K）热损 6.9 W/m；伴热失电冻结窗口 6.8 h；火星重力使 12 m 扬程仅需 44.5 kPa
pois.sim_en: Cold case (water at +2 C, night sky at 193 K): 6.9 W/m loss, and 6.8 h of freeze margin if the trace loses power. Mars gravity means 12 m of lift costs only 44.5 kPa.

pois.label: 储水罐 A（服务罐）
pois.detail: 13 m³ 卧式保温储罐，双鞍座支撑，顶部人孔，罐端接收井下来水。与西侧备用罐 B（res-tank-02）经倒罐线互联构成 26 m³ 尘暴水银行：尘暴来临前自动蓄满，全球尘暴期间光伏出力骤降时由库存供水。
pois.detail_en: A 13 m3 horizontal insulated tank on twin saddles with a top manway, taking water straight from the well. It is cross-tied to tank B (res-tank-02) to the west, and the pair form a 26 m3 dust-storm water bank: filled automatically ahead of storm season, then drawn down through a global storm while photovoltaic output collapses.

specs.双罐水银行: 26 m³ ≈ 60 sol 全球尘暴需求 × 114%

pois.sim: TS-01 R1：PV 30 kWp + 双罐在 30 sol 区域尘暴（×0.2）+ 60 sol 全球尘暴（×0.15）压力包线下 700 sol 零断供——该结论经 Stefan 校核不变
pois.sim_en: TS-01 R1: 30 kWp of photovoltaics plus the twin tanks ride the full pressure envelope - a 30-sol regional storm at x0.2 output followed by a 60-sol global storm at x0.15 - for 700 sol with zero outages. The Stefan re-run left this result unchanged.

pois.label: 冰质尾料堆
pois.detail: 钻进与井筒建立阶段排出的含冰风化层碎料，冰-锈色混杂，靠近堆底锈红比例更高（粉尘沉降）。含冰量高的批次可回填作应急水源原料。
pois.detail_en: Ice-bearing cuttings thrown out while drilling and establishing the bore, mottled ice-white and rust. The rust fraction rises toward the base, where settled dust collects. Batches high in ice can be fed back as an emergency water source.

pois.label: 辅助光伏板
pois.detail: 2.3 m 辅助光伏板，仅供仪表、阀门与通信待机功耗。刻意展示的尺度对比：取水主功率需 15 kWe——若走光伏主供电路线，需要约 30 kWp 阵列（相当于此板的一百三十倍面积）加双罐水银行。
pois.detail_en: A 2.3 m panel that powers only instruments, valves and communications standby. The scale contrast is deliberate: extraction itself needs 15 kWe, so running the main load on sunlight would take roughly 30 kWp - about a hundred and thirty times this panel's area - on top of the twin-tank water bank.

specs.主功率来源: 基地电网 15 kWe 或 30 kWp 阵列

specs_en.Main power: 15 kWe from the base grid, or a 30 kWp array

pois.label: 预留井位 WELL-2
pois.detail: 井-1 寿命终点（终期融腔 Ø8.5 m）触发搬迁：封井（套管留井、井口焊封，残腔作应急水库）→ 钻塔沿标定路线拖运 15 m → 新垫层复位钻进 → 管线延长 13 m。全程约 2 sol，期间用水由罐 B 覆盖。
pois.detail_en: End of life for well 1 - final cavity 8.5 m across - triggers the move: seal the well (casing left in place, wellhead welded shut, the residual cavity kept as an emergency reservoir), drag the derrick 15 m along the surveyed path, re-set it on a fresh pad and drill, then extend the line by 13 m. About 2 sol all told, with tank B covering demand throughout.
pois.sim: TS-02：井距按防腔体贯通与地表塌陷设计；单台 10 kWe 独立部署时井寿命仅 241 sol，需再预留井-3
pois.sim_en: TS-02: spacing is set against cavity breakthrough and surface collapse. A standalone 10 kWe deployment would give only 241 sol of well life and would need a third site reserved as well.
